name: active
description: Select markers if they are active (have moved in the last period) or select drawpoints if they are active (current period is past draw period).
notes: MassFlow-specific. The manual documents it on the shared range page but `_common` carries no file for it.
Used by the vendor's own unittests.dat: `massflow marker list range active`.
official_documentation: Itasca 9.7 shared kernel manual: Range Phrase Keyword Reference
